Reference / compression/zstd

compression/zstd#

zstd (RFC 8878): fast compression with ratios near gzip's best, or better, as in .zst files and Content-Encoding: zstd (#184).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let packed = ZstdCompressed(data).bytes();
let data = ZstdDecompressed(origin: packed, limit: 10485760).bytes();

Description#

zstd (RFC 8878): fast compression with ratios near gzip's best, or better, as in .zst files and Content-Encoding: zstd (#184). One frame per stream, with a content checksum.

A stream goes through the Compressing and Decompressing roles, for example with compression/read:

let packed = CompressedReading(origin: input, compressor: ZstdCompressor());

Decompression is bounded: limit is the most bytes it may produce, past which it throws CompressionLimitExceeded; damaged data is InvalidCompressedData.

object ZstdDecompressed#

object ZstdDecompressed

Compressed bytes decompressed whole, at most limit bytes of them: one frame, whose window may be at most 128 MiB. Bytes after the end of the frame are InvalidCompressedData.

ZstdDecompressed.ZstdDecompressed#

ZstdDecompressed(origin is @byte, limit is int)

Decompresses origin whole, producing at most limit bytes.

The decompressed bytes; more than limit is CompressionLimitExceeded, damaged data InvalidCompressedData.
